summary.intent: Continue CipherBox development by checking project status, then discussing and beginning planning for Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) after learning phases 24 and 25 are already in PR review.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md were created and committed, a validation strategy (VALIDATION.md) was written, and the planning session was in progress when the transcript ended — planner agent had been spawned but had not yet returned.

repo: Phases 24 and 25 were already in PR review, making Phase 26 the next active work item
Phase 18 explicitly deferred Grafana alerting as 'observation only, alerts premature before baselines' — Phase 26 is the payoff for that decision
Grafana Cloud requires HTTP API provisioning for alert rules — file-based provisioning (docker/grafana/) does not work for cloud-hosted Grafana
Five histograms already instrumented: HTTP requests, IPFS/IPNS general, republish batch, IPNS resolve, IPNS publish
Single Grafana dashboard strategy: extend cipherbox-staging.json per phase rather than creating separate dashboards
Client-side perf instrumentation (sdk-core/src/perf.ts) is gated to non-production only via NODE_ENV check
Existing timeouts: Kubo 30s, Pinata 60s, PSA 30s, delegated routing 10s, TEE 30s, connection probe 5s
Phase 22 journey baselines: login-to-vault 23,569ms, upload-to-visible 1,355ms (100KB), share-to-accessible 3,039ms

code.finding: 5 gauges (DB-polled every 30s), 8+ counters (event-driven), 5 histograms covering HTTP, IPFS/IPNS, TEE batch, IPNS resolve, and IPNS publish operations

Most comprehensive retry pattern in the codebase: 3 attempts, 1s base delay, 30s max delay, respects Retry-After header for 429s, exponential backoff for network errors, immediate failure for non-retryable 4xx/5xx
Non-production gate: enabled when NODE_ENV !== 'production' OR globalThis.__CIPHERBOX_PERF__ === true — the escape hatch flag allows enabling in prod if needed
401 handler uses a shared promise to deduplicate concurrent refresh calls — prevents multiple token refresh requests when multiple in-flight requests get 401 simultaneously
Scrapes both CipherBox API /metrics and Kubo /debug/metrics/prometheus every 30s; ships metrics to Grafana Cloud Mimir, logs to Grafana Cloud Loki

workflow: GSD auto-advance chain (--auto flag) flattens nested agent calls via Skill tool to avoid runtime freezes from deep agent nesting
Researcher agent auto-commits its output file, causing duplicate commit attempts if the orchestrator also tries to commit — need to check recent commits before committing research artifacts
When PRs are in review for upcoming phases, the GSD progress workflow still routes to those phases — requires manual override to skip to the next unreviewed phase

friction: Researcher agent committed 26-RESEARCH.md itself, but the orchestrator then attempted to commit it again — required multiple bash commands to diagnose the duplicate commit situation
Feature branch creation happened mid-workflow (after scout started) rather than at the start — minor ordering issue in the discuss-phase workflow
GSD progress check showed Phase 24 as next even though it was already in PR review — no mechanism in the planning state to mark phases as 'in review'
